response.overview: This documentary explores the phenomenon behind Chi come me, a hit theatrical production directed by Andrée Ruth Shammah and written by Roy Chen. Following its final sold-out run at Milan's Teatro Franco Parenti, the film examines how a powerful story about five fragile teenagers in a mental health center finding their voice through theater transformed into an intergenerational cult experience and a profound mirror of contemporary adolescent struggles.
response.tagline: When the stage becomes a mirror for a generation.
response.title: L’ultimo abbraccio “Chi come me”
